name: memory
title: Memory
description: Manage standing user preferences and constraints. Save what the user asks you to remember and report its exact text and scope; an entry you propose yourself, or one whose scope is unclear, waits for the user's approval. Load memory-management for curation policy; stored history uses recall.

op.description: Manage user-curated standing memory only. list defaults to active entries; include_inactive:true also shows archived entries. Generated conversation history belongs to recall.

id.description: edit/delete: per-project memory index from list, paired with project_id and index_revision.

index_revision.description: Required for edit/delete: exact scope version returned by list. Indices compact after deletion or movement; stale versions are rejected. Read the list again, never guess.

include_inactive.description: list only: default false returns active standing memories. Set true to also inspect archived user-curated records.

summary.description: Durable content; required for add and edit. The internal title is derived from its first 40 characters.

project_id.description: Pool: omit for the current Project, "common" for common memory, or a Project slug; "*" is list only.

agent_id.description: Agent memory instead of project_id: "self" is your own pool, read and injected only for you; an unattended run writes only there. The representative agent (lead) may list or delete another agent's by its id.
